dcterms:description: The Icelandic Parsed Historical Corpus (IcePaHC) is a Penn-style treebank that is lemmatised, part-of-speech tagged, and annotated for constituent structure, containing approximately 1,000,000 words from 61 text extracts spanning 10 centuries (1150-2008).
dcterms:title: Icelandic Parsed Historical Corpus (IcePaHC)
